description: `outcomeTo` on a verb that is not a seam verb fails validation as ACTION_FIELDS_INVALID. `set` completes synchronously against the renderer's own in-memory tree and cannot be refused, so an outcome binding there is a declaration with nothing on the other end — a control gated on `pending` that would never leave it, rejected statically rather than discovered at render time.

errors.message: "set" completes locally and produces no outcome — `outcomeTo` is valid only on submit/create/delete/call-action (UIS-167)
